decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the core offer and kept its own page in both years, which signals results that meet aspirations, and the expanding firm has the slack to keep developing it.

Moving from a mention to a page of its own in 2024 points to growing internal commitment, and apron connectivity supports the firm's digital integration strategy, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.

Billing software was upgraded to its own page in 2024 and adds to the software and service portfolio, but it is somewhat further from airside operations, so it carries slightly more risk if returns fall below aspirations.
Equipment monitoring builds on the large installed base and fits the move toward lifecycle services, and its 2024 upgrade to its own page suggests satisfactory results that a growing firm can carry.
